assessment_objectives.objective: roles and responsibilities exist to compel data and/or process owners to meet documented Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT) operator and practitioner proficiency requirements.
the organization assesses Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Autonomous Technologies (AAT)-related operator and practitioner proficiency requirements per an organization-defined frequency.
